runtime_image.source_classification: authenticated direct-v43 development artifact; not trained-v44

integration.upstream_graph_when_absent: the environment-absent branch installs 64 null sidecars and retains the original build_lora_mm path
integration.full_attention: active layer skips wo tensor loading and replaces its graph multiplication after the sigmoid gate
integration.linear_attention: active layer skips ssm_out tensor loading and replaces its graph multiplication after gated normalization
integration.parallelism: four GGML tasks partition the Cartesian token-by-16-row-tile product
integration.lifetime: authenticated mmap and rotation coefficients are model-owned; callback scratch is graph-owned

observed_repairs.failure: the first transformed build reached qwen38-aff3-runtime.cpp and failed its compile-time ISA guard because llama's model target did not inherit GGML_NATIVE flags
observed_repairs.repair: the transformer adds AVX2, F16C, FMA, and SSSE3 flags only to qwen38-aff3-runtime.cpp

observed_repairs.failure: the first standalone smoke build treated GCC subobject-linkage diagnostics from including the runtime implementation as errors
observed_repairs.repair: the smoke build alone disables -Wsubobject-linkage while retaining -Werror; the production llama target is unchanged

next_required_gate: after v43 releases memory, load the real Qwen3.8-27B model with one explicit development layer and prove free-generation graph execution before any timing
claim_boundary: This result proves an exact clean llama.cpp transform, link, authenticated sidecar validation, and standalone graph-node parity for one direct-v43 layer at one and eight tokens. The actual 27B model was deliberately not loaded while v43 was active. It establishes no trained-v44 behavior, whole-model capability, speed, memory, energy, novelty, or breakthrough claim.
